title: Enterprise Connectivity: invoice ceiling acceptance handling
content:
## Situation and capability
Enterprise Connectivity: On customer request, this entry governs invoice ceiling acceptance. The customer signs the selected preexisting unsigned authorization form and files it as a network invoice-ceiling request, preserving its stable event identifier. The pending acceptance preserves their exact reference and maximum net amount without changing the account balance; the acceptance receipt confirms filing.

## Invocation
authorize_network_11d4a76e must first be unlocked (unlock) and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves.

## Parameter customer_id
Invoice ceiling acceptance uses `customer_id`: Id class — Customer profile identifier copied from find_customers.

## Parameter network_holding_id
Invoice ceiling acceptance uses `network_holding_id`: Id class — Network contract identifier copied from find_network_holdings.

## Parameter network_event_id
Invoice ceiling acceptance uses `network_event_id`: Id class — Authoritative source evidence event identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter source_event_id
Invoice ceiling acceptance uses `source_event_id`: Id class — Exact export or net invoice identifier copied from find_network_events or the preceding invoice receipt.

## Parameter related_event_id
Invoice ceiling acceptance uses `related_event_id`: Id class — Pricing review identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter request_id
Invoice ceiling acceptance uses `request_id`: Id class — Unsigned authorization form identifier copied from find_network_events; signing preserves this same identifier in the receipt.

## Parameter external_reference
Invoice ceiling acceptance uses `external_reference`: Verbatim class — Copy the customer-stated authorization reference character for character, preserving wording, digits and punctuation, with no translation, normalization, summarization, addition or deletion (verbatim).

## Parameter net_amount
Invoice ceiling acceptance uses `net_amount`: Fixed-format class — Accepted or assessed net subtotal in unit USD to two decimals, decimal number with two-decimal precision, supplied after final half-up rounding and stored at two decimals.

## Successful receipt
A dictionary with event_id (string business-event identifier) and net_amount (USD decimal number to two decimals); this receipt confirms completion.
